divine mercy devotions with adoration & confession 7-8pm church of the nativity thursday 29th october 2026 everyone welcome foodbank team this time of year is the busiest for the foodbank. winter and the extra demands of christmas are approaching. sadly it is often a time when stocks are at their lowest. as always thank you for your generous support. we would like to ask those who do not presently donate, to consider joining us. every little helps. thank you sensory-friendly mass invitation st colmcille’s parish (ballyhackamore belfast bt4 3jb) warmly invites you to our monthly sensory mass on saturday, 31st october at 12:00 noon . this special mass is designed to be inclusive and welcoming for individuals and families who may benefit from a quieter, more relaxed worship environment. the short mass will feature: gentle lighting and sound; a calm and supportive atmosphere; space to move around if needed; sensory items to aid regulation; a warm welcome for all ages and abilities. whether you or a loved one experience sensory sensitivities, or simply wish to attend a short peaceful and reflective service, we would love to see you there. refreshments after mass. leinster retreat day – all welcome catholic mothers ireland invite you to our leinster retreat day on saturday, 7th nov, from 10am –6pm at ely house. a day of prayer, reflection, and spiritual renewal with guest speakers fr dominik domagala, dr iva beranek and mrs maria steen. lunch and refreshments provided. cost: €50 booking:
www.catholicmothers.ie/retreats

all welcome — bring a friend. - sinéad strong, director catholic mothers ireland ltd is registered with the charity commission for northern ireland nic110669 save the date! all are invited to come and hear from representatives of 6 christian churches who will consider: 'who is mary in god’s plan of salvation?' martina purdy will present on behalf of the roman catholic tradition. there also will be time for audience questions, chaired by alf mccreary (belfast telegraph, bbc news) this is an opportunity to listen and understand other perspectives. wednesday, 2 december 2026 at 7pm in corr’s corner hotel, newtownabbey. refreshments will be served. to aid in planning please rsvp to
ecumenical@downandconnor.org

down & connor vacancy – assistant housekeeper – closing date tuesday 27th october 12 noon catholic mothers ireland – leinster retreat 7th november join cappella caeciliana for the road home , an inspiring evening of choral music exploring themes of belonging, journey, community and hope. directed by james grossmith, the concert features guest artists ruth mcginley (piano) and thomas isaac (cello). the performance marks st cecilia's day, the choir's patronal feast, and celebrates 31 years of cappella caeciliana. day pilgrimage to knock on monday 2nd november for feast of all souls, leaving st agnes at 7.30am. price £30 (includes tea and scone). contact pat

. knock all night pilgrimage 7th – 8th december pioneer association - mass to remember deceased members a mass to remember all deceased members of the pioneer association will take place on friday 20 november in st agnes' church, andersonstown road, belfast at 7 pm. light refreshments afterwards. all pioneers welcome. november short-term pledge the month of november offers a special opportunity to make a small sacrifice in honour of the sacred heart of jesus. we invite parishioners and friends to consider taking a short-term pledge throughout november. pioneer offering - "i promise, in honour of the sacred heart of jesus, and with the help of the blessed virgin mary, to abstain from all intoxicating substances until the end of november." please consider joining with others in prayer, sacrifice and support for those affected by addiction.
